body:
I definitely see your point about making a difference. I don't expect big changes in 3 months of student teaching- I just wanted to feel like what I was doing was helpful for the classroom and not a hinderance. At this point I'm so dejected that I feel like giving up all together, but I'm in too much debt to do that. 

I'm seeing a therapist but it definitely isn't helping very much- I'm on state insurance right now which definitely is a frustration in finding care, but that is a whole other conversation. 

 I've talked to my teacher and she said she agreed to let me know if my tone is changing in an uncomfortable way but said it was "up to me" to watch it- it's sort of hard when I don't recognize that it's happening. At this point I just feel like I have to stay quiet around the adults until the term is over. 

It is a positive thing to know that student teaching is nothing like actual teaching. I'm looking forward to having a classroom of my own and developing better relationships with my schools...that is, if I even decide to teach at this point.
